title: Comment (one line of comments.jsonl)
description: profiles/<slug>/tickets/<id>/comments.jsonl: one compact JSON object per line, appended by Store.addComment. Type Comment in src/server/types.ts. Holds the ticket's result summaries (author ai), board notes such as 'Run failed: ...' (author ai), the user's comments, and notes left by other tickets' runs (author ai with from). Saved keys are masked in text. Unknown fields must be kept.

from.description: Ticket id of the run that left this note.
